Hi, my name is Konomi.
I'm from Japan. I'm used to living with other people.
I’m interested in this property and would like to arrange a viewing.
Could you please let me know when it would be convenient?
Thank you very much.
I really want to live here. I’d like to sign the contract on the day of the viewing if possible.
